title: Leaving the Philippines via Golden Phoenix Hotel
description:
Golden Phoenix Hotel in Manila is one of the best hotels in Manila which has convenient access to Manila Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA).  The Golden Phoenix is also has convenient access to the Mall of Asia.  Definitely recommend this place if you are in transit in Manila and need a 1-2 night stay.  

We traveled from Boracay to Manila then finally back to Tokyo Japan.

If you liked this video, please hit that thumbs up button and if you want to see more of my adventures hit that subscribe button.  Hope to see you again in the next video.
